_comment: Seam warp pairs that REPLACE a pokeemerald map CONNECTION with a synthetic two-cell direction-gated ARROW-WARP pair (MB_NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST_ARROW_WARP). Used ONLY when the two maps cannot share a tileset: their unique-8x8-tile union exceeds the hard 1024-tile cap and both metatile dedup and unreferenced-metatile pruning are measured-exhausted. This is a user-approved fidelity substitution (loses cross-map scroll-stitching at this one seam), not a general connection replacement — most seams stay real connections. Schema: cells_a[i] pairs 1:1 with cells_b[i] (reciprocal warp cells, geometry-verified passable + connection-offset-consistent). direction_a/direction_b name the arrow direction (up/down/left/right = the travel direction that fires the warp) each side's cells carry; see rpg2gba.tileset_converter.seam_warps.

seams._note: Kevlar Town (map 31) <-> Route 2 (map 35), CH04. Union of the two maps' tilesets measures 1028 8x8 tiles against the 1024 cap. Seam row y=0 on Kevlar (blocked x: 8,18,25,26,37,39,40), y=56 on Route 2 (blocked x: 14-19,26,28,29); connection offset 11 (route2_x = kevlar_x - 11). Cells verified passable + offset-consistent by decoding the emitted map.bin collision bits.
